# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: BUSCO four-proteome shared complete single-copy orthologs
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir -p db runs
unzip -q "$(inputs.lineage_zip.path)" -d db
busco --version > busco_version.txt
busco --offline --in "$(inputs.animals_cele.path)" --lineage_dataset db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out Animals_Cele --out_path runs --cpu 4 --force
busco --offline --in "$(inputs.animals_ggal.path)" --lineage_dataset db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out Animals_Ggal --out_path runs --cpu 4 --force
busco --offline --in "$(inputs.fungi_ncra.path)" --lineage_dataset db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out Fungi_Ncra --out_path runs --cpu 4 --force
busco --offline --in "$(inputs.fungi_scer.path)" --lineage_dataset db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10 --mode proteins --out Fungi_Scer --out_path runs --cpu 4 --force
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
labels = ["Animals_Cele", "Animals_Ggal", "Fungi_Ncra", "Fungi_Scer"]
sets = []
status_maps = {}
for label in labels:
    table = Path("runs") / label / "run_eukaryota_odb10" / "full_table.tsv"
    if not table.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing BUSCO full table: {table}")
    statuses = {}
    for line in table.read_text().splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        fields = line.split("\t")
        if len(fields) >= 2:
            statuses[fields[0]] = fields[1]
    status_maps[label] = statuses
    sets.append({busco_id for busco_id, status in statuses.items() if status == "Complete"})
shared = set.intersection(*sets)
with open("shared_complete_single_copy.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("BUSCO_id\tAnimals_Cele\tAnimals_Ggal\tFungi_Ncra\tFungi_Scer\n")
    for busco_id in sorted(shared):
        out.write(busco_id + "\t" + "\t".join(status_maps[label][busco_id] for label in labels) + "\n")
with open("busco_run_summaries.txt", "w") as out:
    out.write(Path("busco_version.txt").read_text())
    out.write("\nLINEAGE CONFIGURATION\n")
    out.write(Path("db/lineages/eukaryota_odb10/dataset.cfg").read_text())
    for label in labels:
        matches = list((Path("runs") / label).glob("short_summary.specific.*.txt"))
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"expected one specific-lineage summary for {label}, found {len(matches)}")
        out.write(f"\n===== {label} =====\n")
        out.write(matches[0].read_text())
PY
